subject: Interview for Senior Frontend Engineer — flight cancelled, proposed split + async option
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@gmail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Interview scheduling — Senior Frontend Engineer (Dec 9, 10:00am PT)

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for applying and taking the time to speak with us. We have your on-site-style loop scheduled for Wednesday, Dec 9 at 10:00am PT. The panel will include:
- Marissa Cole (Hiring Manager) — product/design conversation
- Jonas Weber — frontend system design + coding
- Karthik Iyer — backend integration questions

Attached is the resume I have on file. Please reply if any of this conflicts with your schedule. We’ll send a calendar invite shortly.

Attachments: JordanLee_Resume.pdf (pdf)

Best,
Mina Haddad
Technical Recruiting Lead
Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@gmail.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 17:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Interview scheduling — Senior Frontend Engineer (Dec 9, 10:00am PT)

Hi Mina —

Really sorry for the late note: my flight into SF was canceled this morning due to a crew shortage and the earliest they can get me in is late Thursday. I can join remotely but I won’t have stable video for the full 2.5-hour loop (hotel options nearby are sold out tonight).

If we can split the loop (do the product + hiring manager conversation tomorrow remotely, and either record or do a take-home for the deep coding exercise), I’m happy to do that. Alternatively, I can move everything to Friday afternoon or next week — whatever works best for the team.

Apologies again — please let me know your recommendation.

Thanks,
Jordan
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@gmail.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 18:20:00 -0800
Subject: Candidate flight canceled — options (split loop / async take-home / reschedule)

Team — Jordan’s flight was canceled; he has limited video bandwidth tomorrow. He proposed:
1) Split the loop: product + hiring manager remotely (30–45m), postpone coding to a separate session.
2) Replace live coding with a 48–72h take-home (focused frontend task) that we can review asynchronously.
3) Push to Fri or next week if preferred.

Quick asks: please reply with your availability and preference. If anyone can’t make next week, call them out so I can propose a backup interviewer.

Calendar link: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/abc123

Thanks,
Mina
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 18:33:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Candidate flight canceled — options (split loop / async take-home / reschedule)

I can do the product/hiring manager conversation tomorrow at 10:00am PT remotely (30–40m). I prefer a 48h take-home rather than a rushed live coding loop — gives us a better sense of the candidate’s code quality.

If we go that route, let’s ask Jonas to handle the coding review when he’s back available; otherwise we can bring Soojin in for the backend/frontend integration questions.

-Marissa
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 19:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Candidate flight canceled — options (split loop / async take-home / reschedule)

I can do the deep frontend coding review, but I’m out of office Thurs–Mon (conference). If we need someone to run a live integration question next week, I’m not available.

I agree with a take-home — I’ll review it asynchronously when I’m back (give me 72h to write notes if needed). If you want a live follow-up sooner, loop in Soojin.

-Jonas
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 19:19:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Candidate flight canceled — options (split loop / async take-home / reschedule)

I can’t do Friday or next week afternoon due to onboarding demos I’m leading. If we need a backend/integration interviewer, please CC Soojin — she can cover next week morning slots.

-Karthik
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@gmail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Interview scheduling — Plan B confirmed (split + take-home)

Hi Jordan — thanks for the quick update and sorry again about the disrupted travel. Here’s what we’ll do:

1) Keep the product + hiring manager conversation tomorrow at 10:00am PT (30–40m) — invite sent. Marissa will own that.
2) Replace the live coding loop with a take-home frontend exercise (attached). You’ll have 48 hours from receipt to submit; we’ll accept a short writeup + link to a public repo or zip.
3) Jonas is OOO later this week; he’ll review the take-home asynchronously. If we need a live follow-up, Soojin will cover backend/integration and can do morning slots next week.

Attachments: Frontend_Takehome.pdf
Submission: please send a link or zip to mina_haddad@redwood.com within 48 hours.

If anything changes on your side, reply here and we’ll adapt. Looking forward to the conversation tomorrow.

Best,
Mina
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@gmail.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Dec 2026 14:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Interview scheduling — Plan B confirmed (split + take-home)

Thanks Mina & team — that plan works for me. I received the take-home and will submit within 48 hours. I’ll be on the 10:00am PT call tomorrow for the product conversation (remote).

Appreciate the flexibility.

—Jordan
